help: stage a manifest and its payload: the manifest moved from where the download left it, each file it lists fetched from its one-use export_url through the Safari session - each download named by the export's star - and unpacked into the data-* directory sharing that star (manifest-<X>.json beside data-<X>/); refused if that directory is staged or held

args.name: --manifest
args.help: the manifest, wherever the download left it - required: each export_url is one-use, so no default picks one

args.name: --to
args.help: stage under a directory instead of the stage (test escape hatch - a directory, never a machine name)

x: --manifest <file> (consumed: moved into the stage as the unit's record; moved back where nothing was fetched)
~/Downloads (where Safari puts what the verb fetches, moved out on arrival)

osascript: drives Safari against the logged-in session - fronting claude.ai, evaluating JS in the front document (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
fetch (in-page, session-authenticated): GETs each export_url the manifest lists; each URL is one-use, so the fetch consumes it (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
